name: Pending Cancellation Reason 9 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why the cancellation request has a pending status.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Transaction/instruction received after the account servicer's specified deadline.

DQCS.name: Amount Rejection
DQCS.definition: Unrecognised or invalid instructed cash amount.

ECRD.name: Election To Counterparty Response Deadline Missed
ECRD.definition: Received after the election to counterparty response market deadline.
